guarantees.claim: When NPower equals 4, a_mul_ax_b is assigned aes_mul_gf2p4(a_x_calc, b) and b_mul_bx_b is assigned aes_mul_gf2p4(b_x_calc, b).
When NPower does not equal 4, a_mul_ax_b is assigned aes_mul_gf2p2(a_x_calc, b) and b_mul_bx_b is assigned aes_mul_gf2p2(b_x_calc, b).
a_q is always driven as the XOR of a_mul_x_z and a_mul_ax_b.
b_q is always driven as the XOR of b_mul_x_z and b_mul_bx_b.
A compile-time assertion (ASSERT_INIT) enforces that NPower is either 4 or 2; any other value triggers an error.

assumptions.claim: The functions aes_mul_gf2p4 and aes_mul_gf2p2 must correctly compute multiplication in GF(2^4) and GF(2^2) respectively.
assumptions.cond: when NPower selects the corresponding multiplier
assumptions.risk: Incorrect multiplication breaks the masked output sharing, potentially leaking secret data via side-channels.

assumptions.claim: The signal b must carry fresh, uniform random mask bits for each blinded multiplication; reuse or correlation diminishes masking.
assumptions.cond: always during computation of a_q, b_q
assumptions.risk: Predictable or stale b can cause first-order side-channel leakage of the secret shares.

assumptions.claim: The inputs a_x_calc, b_x_calc, a_mul_x_z, b_mul_x_z must be correctly masked share values as required by the DOM scheme; this module does not verify their validity.
assumptions.risk: If these inputs are not properly shared, the final outputs a_q and b_q may expose secret‑dependent correlations.

uncertain_points.claim: If the ASSERT_INIT is disabled or not checked, NPower values other than 2 or 4 will be accepted and the generate default (gen_mul_gf2p2) will silently produce an incorrect GF(2^2) multiplication for all other field sizes.
uncertain_points.risk: Masked multiplication will be wrong, potentially breaking the masking countermeasure and enabling secret extraction via side-channel attacks.
